description: This file defines the 'CustomerTransaction' class which constitutes an administrative controller for handling customer transaction reports within the OpenCart extension. It includes methods for displaying, saving settings, and generating reports related to customer transactions.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer transaction reports in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes actions for index display, saving configurations, and report generation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer transaction report form, initializes breadcrumb navigation, and loads necessary resources.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings related to the customer transaction report, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the main customer transaction report page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of customer transactions, typically in JSON format.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and formats report data based on filter criteria such as date range and customer, returning the report HTML or data.
